"""Small standard-library-only file I/O helpers."""

from pathlib import Path


def read_text(path) -> str:
    """Read the full contents of a file as UTF-8 text."""
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def write_text(path, text, *, append=False) -> None:
    """Write text to a file as UTF-8.

    Creates a missing file. Overwrites by default, or appends when
    append=True. Does not create missing parent directories.
    """
    mode = "a" if append else "w"
    with open(path, mode, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(text)
entries.contract: UTF-8 text module: read_text(path) returns all text; write_text(path,text,*,append=False) creates files, overwrites by default, appends only when requested. Accepts str/Path. Missing reads raise FileNotFoundError. Does NOT create parent directories. No binary API, encoding parameter, or exclusive-create behavior.
